title: Golf
shortDescription: Golf helps define a Nintendo Entertainment System sports path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Builds a traceable sports option into the Nintendo Entertainment System discovery path.
Links the catalog entry to a source record without presenting a rating.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Classified for the Nintendo Entertainment System sports discovery path using Wikidata-listed platform and genre statements; this remains a catalog-method note with no imported numerical signal.
